title: Prioritize reproducible evidence command over visual markdown rendering in Hunch cards
context: Hunch (engineering memory system) was rebased; documentation grounding refresh syncs guidance with current state and practices. Touches invariant(s): con_039cee7367 (Memory hygiene is the agent's job, done without waiting for the human: accept shipped roadmap proposals, settle provenance-repair escalations (apply the true commit or drop), re-anchor or stale findings, and land the resulting capture commits through a PR. Only decisions that need genuine product judgment are queued for the human.).
decision: Changed evidence presentation guidance from 'render markdown evidence link outside code block for clickability' to 'copy card verbatim including Evidence line (the command that generates the local report on demand)' — shift from presentation polish to actionable reproducibility.
consequences: Evidence preservation prioritizes direct command access over markdown formatting
Users can reproduce evidence trails locally by running the Evidence command directly
Agents must preserve Evidence line verbatim when presenting cards, not selectively render markdown
alternatives_rejected: Keep old guidance: focus on visual markdown rendering outside code blocks
Omit Evidence line from verbatim card copy
